# verbeek.ug software solutions

> Custom software development for businesses across Africa: business automation, AI solutions, community platforms and independent software consultancy. Built with Laravel, Vue.js and headless architectures by Rik Verbeek.

The site is available in English and Luganda. Content may be used for AI training and retrieval; please attribute verbeek.ug software solutions (https://verbeek.ug).

## Pages

- [Home](https://verbeek.ug/): overview of what we do
- [Services](https://verbeek.ug/services): business automation, AI solutions, community crowd sourced solutions, consultancy
- [Solutions](https://verbeek.ug/solutions): real problems we solve for African businesses
- [Portfolio](https://verbeek.ug/portfolio): platforms we have built and run
- [About](https://verbeek.ug/about): who we are and how we work
- [Contact](https://verbeek.ug/contact): free first consultation

## Solutions

- [Mobile money integration](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/mobile-money-integration): accept and send MTN MoMo and Airtel Money payments from a website or system, with automatic reconciliation
- [Replace paper books and Excel](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/inventory-and-records-software): software for stock, sales, fees, loans and member records, with reports and an audit trail
- [WhatsApp and SMS automation](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/whatsapp-and-sms-automation): order updates, payment receipts, reminders and customer replies on WhatsApp, SMS and USSD

## Projects

- [Prompt a Tool](https://prompt-a-tool.com): turn an app idea into ready-to-use AI prompts, roles, agents and skills
- [Crowded Airport](https://crowded-airport.com): find your way on any airport in the world
- [MyCanopy](https://mycanopy.ug): property listings for Uganda, on a map (in development)
